SELECT 
    filtered_dt.d_year,
    item.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
    item.i_brand AS brand,
    SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM 
    store_sales
    INNER JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT 
            d_date_sk,
            d_year
        FROM 
            date_dim
        WHERE 
            d_moy = 11

WHERE 
    item.i_manufact_id = 816
GROUP BY 
    filtered_dt.d_year,
    item.i_brand,
    item.i_brand_id
ORDER BY 
    filtered_dt.d_year,
    SUM(ss_sales_price) DESC,
    item.i_brand_id
LIMIT 100
